paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.61 as of October 30, representing a decline of 8.74% from the prior close and 38% over the past 23 sessions.

Fermi Inc. has seen recent news coverage, with headlines such as "Fermi (FRMI) Stock Looks About Right At Current Levels" and "Is Fermi (FRMI) A Bargain Following Its Sharp Selloff?" from Yahoo Finance on October 27, discussing the company's stock price and its sharp decline over the past year and recent months.

There have been various SEC filings, including 4 Form 4 filings and 3 Form 144 filings, with recent filings including a Form 8-K on October 16 announcing an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd. Insider transactions have also been reported, with officers, directors, or 10% holders buying, selling, or being granted company stock, as seen in Form 4 filings on October 22 and October 15.
